Interactive AI Twin (a working artifact, not a chatbot widget):
- The site's assistant is an agent with real tool calling: search_work, get_case_study, get_metric, compare_systems, and navigate_to.
- Tool calls, latency, grounding sources, and refusals are shown to the visitor in a trace footer.
- get_metric returns "not measured" for any figure not published, so the agent declines rather than estimating.
- Available at https://nikunj.codenex.dev/#ai-twin

Engineering case studies (deepest technical detail on this site) — 13 write-ups, indexed by theme at https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work:

Agent systems:
- LLM Evaluation Platform (OpenTelemetry + Langfuse, 9 AI surfaces, LLM-as-a-judge validated at Cohen's kappa >= 0.7, Jenkins CI gates): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/llm-evaluation-platform
- Governed MCP Tool Registry (9 of 14 production MCP servers, OAuth2/RBAC tool-level authorization, protocol RCA): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/governed-mcp-registry
- Documentation Automation Platform (multi-agent pipeline with a clarification gate that blocks drafting until open questions are answered): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/documentation-automation
- Sentinel Test Generation Agent (multi-step agent grounded in a code graph; downstream automation fails loudly without linked coverage): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/sentinel-test-agent

Retrieval and context:
- Knowledge Graph RAG (1M+ entities in Neo4j and pgvector, five-layer retrieval evaluation): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/knowledge-graph-rag
- Business Data Layer for Agents (the governed data layer behind the business agents; 19 dashboards at parity, schema pruned 32 to 12 tables): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/bi-platform
- Fantasy GPT (multi-step reasoning SQL RAG on a fine-tuned in-house model, answering live cricket questions in under 30s; 98% of complex queries resolved): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/fantasy-gpt

Platform and reliability:
- Code Intelligence Gateway (agent code search over 8 repositories; storage-throughput root cause found via a 76KB copy taking 14 minutes): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/code-intelligence-gateway
- CodeNex AI API Proxy (open-source gateway fronting 6 provider backends with health-aware failover and automatic recovery): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/codenex-ai-proxy

AI products:
- CodeNex (prompt-to-React-app builder on a Spring Cloud microservice backend with per-project Kubernetes preview environments): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/codenex
- AIKO (personalized voice sports companion; persona building, live match reasoning, catch-up highlight reels with AI commentary in 20+ languages; presented at IBC 2024): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/aiko
- Serenify (AI wellness product with database-enforced per-user isolation, granular AI data-access controls, and explicit crisis-resource surfacing): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/serenify
- Quill (desktop review app keeping AI-drafted documentation reviewable; permissions delegated entirely to the source-control platform): https://nikunj.codenex.dev/work/quill
